abil.Leaf Guard: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.
abil.Scrappy: The Pokémon can hit Ghost-type Pokémon with Normal- and Fighting-type moves.
abil.Early Bird: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.
abil.Water Veil: The Pokémon is covered with a water veil, which prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.
abil.Filter: Reduces the power of supereffective attacks taken.
abil.Swarm: Powers up Bug-type moves when the Pokémon’s HP is low.

abil.Forewarn: When it enters a battle, the Pokémon can tell one of the moves an opposing Pokémon has.
abil.Dazzling: Surprises the opposing Pokémon, making it unable to attack using priority moves.

abil.Volt Absorb: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move instead of taking damage.

abil.Strong Jaw: The Pokémon’s strong jaw boosts the power of its biting moves.
abil.Immunity: The immune system of the Pokémon prevents it from getting poisoned.

abil.Fur Coat: Halves the damage from physical moves.

abil.Fluffy: Halves the damage taken from moves that make direct contact, but doubles that of Fire-type moves.

abil.Sap Sipper: Boosts the Attack stat if hit by a Grass-type move instead of taking damage.

moves.name: Pound
moves.desc: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

moves.name: Karate Chop
moves.desc: The target is attacked with a sharp chop. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Double Slap
moves.desc: The target is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Comet Punch
moves.desc: The target is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Mega Punch
moves.desc: The target is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Pay Day
moves.desc: Numerous coins are hurled at the target to inflict damage. Money is earned after the battle.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.desc: The target is punched with a fiery fist. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.desc: The target is punched with an icy fist. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.desc: The target is punched with an electrified fist. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.desc: Hard, pointed, sharp claws rake the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Vise Grip
moves.desc: The target is gripped and squeezed from both sides to inflict damage.

moves.name: Guillotine
moves.desc: A vicious, tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

moves.name: Razor Wind
moves.desc: In this two-turn attack, blades of wind hit opposing Pokémon on the second turn. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.desc: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Cut
moves.desc: The target is cut with a scythe or claw. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

moves.name: Gust
moves.desc: A gust of wind is whipped up by wings and launched at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Wing Attack
moves.desc: The target is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide to inflict damage.

moves.name: Whirlwind
moves.desc: The target is blown away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Fly
moves.desc: The user flies up into the sky and then strikes its target on the next turn. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

moves.name: Bind
moves.desc: Things such as long bodies or tentacles are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

moves.name: Slam
moves.desc: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

moves.name: Vine Whip
moves.desc: The target is struck with slender, whiplike vines to inflict damage.

moves.name: Stomp
moves.desc: The target is stomped with a big foot. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Double Kick
moves.desc: The target is quickly kicked twice in succession using both feet.

moves.name: Mega Kick
moves.desc: The target is attacked by a kick launched with muscle-packed power.

moves.name: Jump Kick
moves.desc: The user jumps up high, then strikes with a kick. If the kick misses, the user hurts itself.

moves.name: Rolling Kick
moves.desc: The user lashes out with a quick, spinning kick. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Sand Attack
moves.desc: Sand is hurled in the target’s face, reducing the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.desc: The user sticks out its head and attacks by charging straight into the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Horn Attack
moves.desc: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

moves.name: Fury Attack
moves.desc: The target is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Horn Drill
moves.desc: The user stabs the target with a horn that rotates like a drill. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

moves.name: Tackle
moves.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges and slams into the target with its whole body.

moves.name: Body Slam
moves.desc: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Wrap
moves.desc: A long body, vines, or the like are used to wrap and squeeze the target for four to five turns.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.desc: A reckless, full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.desc: A reckless, life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Tail Whip
moves.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making opposing Pokémon less wary and lowering their Defense stats.

moves.name: Poison Sting
moves.desc: The user stabs the target with a poisonous stinger. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Twineedle
moves.desc: The user damages the target twice in succession by jabbing it with two spikes. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Pin Missile
moves.desc: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Leer
moves.desc: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers the Defense stat.

moves.name: Bite
moves.desc: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Growl
moves.desc: The user growls in an endearing way, making opposing Pokémon less wary. This lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Roar
moves.desc: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.

moves.name: Sing
moves.desc: A soothing lullaby is sung in a calming voice that puts the target into a deep slumber.

moves.name: Supersonic
moves.desc: The user generates odd sound waves from its body that confuse the target.

moves.name: Sonic Boom
moves.desc: The target is hit with a destructive shock wave that always inflicts 20 HP damage.

moves.name: Disable
moves.desc: For four turns, this move prevents the target from using the move it last used.

moves.name: Acid
moves.desc: Opposing Pokémon are attacked with a spray of harsh acid. This may also lower their Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Ember
moves.desc: The target is attacked with small flames. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Flamethrower
moves.desc: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Mist
moves.desc: The user cloaks itself and its allies in a white mist that prevents any of their stats from being lowered for five turns.

moves.name: Water Gun
moves.desc: The target is blasted with a forceful shot of water.

moves.name: Hydro Pump
moves.desc: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

moves.name: Surf
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

moves.name: Ice Beam
moves.desc: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Blizzard

moves.name: Psybeam
moves.desc: The target is attacked with a peculiar ray. This may also leave the target confused.

moves.name: Bubble Beam

moves.name: Aurora Beam
moves.desc: The target is hit with a rainbow-colored beam. This may also lower the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.desc: The target is attacked with a powerful beam. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Peck
moves.desc: The target is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

moves.name: Drill Peck
moves.desc: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

moves.name: Submission
moves.desc: The user grabs the target and recklessly dives for the ground. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Low Kick

moves.name: Counter

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.desc: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

moves.name: Mega Drain
moves.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Leech Seed

moves.name: Growth

moves.name: Stun Spore

moves.name: Dragon Rage

moves.name: Fire Spin

moves.name: Thunderbolt

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.desc: The user launches a weak jolt of electricity that paralyzes the target.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.desc: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.desc: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to attack.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.desc: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Fissure

moves.name: Dig
moves.desc: The user burrows into the ground, then attacks on the next turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Toxic

moves.name: Confusion

moves.name: Psychic

moves.name: Hypnosis
moves.desc: The user employs hypnotic suggestion to make the target fall into a deep sleep.

moves.name: Meditate
moves.desc: The user meditates to awaken the power deep within its body and raise its Attack stat.

moves.name: Agility
moves.desc: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.desc: The user lunges at the target at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Rage
moves.desc: As long as this move is in use, the power of rage raises the Attack stat each time the user is hit in battle.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.desc: The user switches places with another party Pokémon. It may also be used to warp to the last Pokémon Center visited. If a wild Pokémon uses this move, it flees.

moves.name: Night Shade
moves.desc: The user makes the target see a frightening mirage. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

moves.name: Mimic
moves.desc: The user copies the target’s last move. The move can be used during battle until the Pokémon is switched out.

moves.name: Screech
moves.desc: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.desc: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Recover
moves.desc: Restoring its own cells, the user restores its own HP by half of its max HP.

moves.name: Harden
moves.desc: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Minimize
moves.desc: The user compresses its body to make itself look smaller, which sharply raises its evasiveness.

moves.name: Smokescreen
moves.desc: The user releases an obscuring cloud of smoke or ink. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Confuse Ray
moves.desc: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

moves.name: Withdraw
moves.desc: The user withdraws its body into its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Defense Curl
moves.desc: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

moves.name: Barrier
moves.desc: The user throws up a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from special attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Haze
moves.desc: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.name: Reflect
moves.desc: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical attacks for five turns.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.desc: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Bide
moves.desc: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back to cause double the damage taken.

moves.name: Metronome
moves.desc: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

moves.name: Mirror Move
moves.desc: The user counters the target by mimicking the target's last move.

moves.name: Self-Destruct
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Egg Bomb
moves.desc: A large egg is hurled at the target with maximum force to inflict damage.

moves.name: Lick
moves.desc: The target is licked with a long tongue, causing damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Smog
moves.desc: The target is attacked with a discharge of filthy gases. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Sludge
moves.desc: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Bone Club
moves.desc: The user clubs the target with a bone. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Fire Blast
moves.desc: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.desc: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

moves.name: Clamp
moves.desc: The target is clamped and squeezed by the user's very thick and sturdy shell for four to five turns.

moves.name: Swift
moves.desc: Star-shaped rays are shot at opposing Pokémon. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Skull Bash
moves.desc: The user tucks in its head to raise its Defense stat on the first turn, then rams the target on the next turn.

moves.name: Spike Cannon
moves.desc: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Constrict
moves.desc: The target is attacked with long, creeping tentacles, vines, or the like. This may also lower the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Amnesia
moves.desc: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Kinesis
moves.desc: The user distracts the target by bending a spoon. This lowers the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Soft-Boiled
moves.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP. It may also be used to heal an ally’s HP outside of battle.

moves.name: High Jump Kick
moves.desc: The target is attacked with a knee kick from a jump. If it misses, the user is hurt instead.

moves.name: Glare
moves.desc: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

moves.name: Dream Eater
moves.desc: The user eats the dreams of a sleeping target. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Poison Gas
moves.desc: A cloud of poison gas is sprayed in the face of opposing Pokémon, poisoning those it hits.

moves.name: Barrage
moves.desc: Round objects are hurled at the target to strike two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Leech Life
moves.desc: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Lovely Kiss
moves.desc: With a scary face, the user tries to force a kiss on the target. If it succeeds, the target falls asleep.

moves.name: Sky Attack
moves.desc: A second-turn attack move where critical hits land more easily. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Transform
moves.desc: The user transforms into a copy of the target right down to having the same move set.

moves.name: Bubble
moves.desc: A spray of countless bubbles is jetted at the opposing Pokémon. This may also lower their Speed stat.

moves.name: Dizzy Punch
moves.desc: The target is hit with rhythmically launched punches. This may also leave the target confused.

moves.name: Spore
moves.desc: The user scatters bursts of spores that induce sleep.

moves.name: Flash
moves.desc: The user flashes a light that lowers the target’s accuracy. It can also be used to illuminate caves.

moves.name: Psywave
moves.desc: The target is attacked with an odd psychic wave. The attack varies in intensity.

moves.name: Splash
moves.desc: The user just flops and splashes around to no effect at all...

moves.name: Acid Armor
moves.desc: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply raising its Defense stat.

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.desc: The target is hammered with a large pincer. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Explosion
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.desc: The target is raked with sharp claws or scythes quickly two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Bonemerang
moves.desc: The user throws the bone it holds. The bone loops around to hit the target twice—coming and going.

moves.name: Rest
moves.desc: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.desc: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Hyper Fang
moves.desc: The user bites hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Sharpen
moves.desc: The user makes its edges more jagged, which raises its Attack stat.

moves.name: Conversion
moves.desc: The user changes its type to become the same type as the move at the top of the list of moves it knows.

moves.name: Tri Attack
moves.desc: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.desc: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target’s HP in half.

moves.name: Slash
moves.desc: The target is attacked with a slash of claws or blades. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.desc: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Struggle
moves.desc: This attack is used in desperation only if the user has no PP. It also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Sketch
moves.desc: It enables the user to permanently learn the move last used by the target. Once used, Sketch disappears.

moves.name: Triple Kick
moves.desc: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

moves.name: Thief
moves.desc: The user attacks and steals the target’s held item simultaneously. The user can’t steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Spider Web
moves.desc: The user ensnares the target with thin, gooey silk so it can't flee from battle.

moves.name: Mind Reader
moves.desc: The user senses the target’s movements with its mind to ensure its next attack does not miss the target.

moves.name: Nightmare
moves.desc: A sleeping target sees a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Snore
moves.desc: This attack can be used only if the user is asleep. The harsh noise may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Curse
moves.desc: A move that works differently for the Ghost type than for all other types.

moves.name: Flail
moves.desc: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Conversion 2
moves.desc: The user changes its type to make itself resistant to the type of the attack the target used last.

moves.name: Aeroblast
moves.desc: A vortex of air is shot at the target to inflict damage. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Cotton Spore
moves.desc: The user releases cotton-like spores that cling to opposing Pokémon, which harshly lowers their Speed stats.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.desc: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Spite
moves.desc: The user unleashes its grudge on the move last used by the target by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Powder Snow
moves.desc: The user attacks with a chilling gust of powdery snow. This may also freeze opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Protect
moves.desc: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Mach Punch
moves.desc: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.desc: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Feint Attack
moves.desc: The user approaches the target disarmingly, then throws a sucker punch. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Sweet Kiss
moves.desc: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.

moves.name: Belly Drum
moves.desc: The user maximizes its Attack stat in exchange for HP equal to half its max HP.

moves.name: Sludge Bomb
moves.desc: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.desc: The user hurls mud in the target’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Octazooka
moves.desc: The user attacks by spraying ink in the target’s face or eyes. This may also lower the target’s accuracy.

moves.name: Spikes
moves.desc: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

moves.name: Zap Cannon
moves.desc: The user fires an electric blast like a cannon to inflict damage and cause paralysis.

moves.name: Foresight
moves.desc: Enables a Ghost-type target to be hit by Normal- and Fighting-type attacks. This also enables an evasive target to be hit.

moves.name: Destiny Bond
moves.desc: After using this move, if the user faints, the Pokémon that landed the knockout hit also faints. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Perish Song
moves.desc: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.

moves.name: Icy Wind
moves.desc: The user attacks with a gust of chilled air. This also lowers opposing Pokémon’s Speed stats.

moves.name: Detect
moves.desc: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Bone Rush
moves.desc: The user strikes the target with a hard bone two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Lock-On
moves.desc: The user takes sure aim at the target. This ensures the next attack does not miss the target.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.desc: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

moves.name: Sandstorm
moves.desc: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to hurt all combatants except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. It raises the Sp. Def stat of Rock types.

moves.name: Giga Drain
moves.desc: A nutrient-draining attack. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Endure
moves.desc: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Charm
moves.desc: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Rollout
moves.desc: The user continually rolls into the target over five turns. It becomes more powerful each time it hits.

moves.name: False Swipe
moves.desc: A restrained attack that prevents the target from fainting. The target is left with at least 1 HP.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.desc: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply raises the target’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Milk Drink
moves.desc: The user restores its own HP by up to half of its max HP. It may also be used to heal an ally’s HP outside of battle.

moves.name: Spark
moves.desc: The user throws an electrically charged tackle at the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Fury Cutter
moves.desc: The target is slashed with scythes or claws. This attack becomes more powerful if it hits in succession.

moves.name: Steel Wing
moves.desc: The target is hit with wings of steel. This may also raise the user’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Mean Look
moves.desc: The user pins the target with a dark, arresting look. The target becomes unable to flee.

moves.name: Attract
moves.desc: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the target becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.desc: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.desc: The user makes a soothing bell chime to heal the status conditions of all the party Pokémon.

moves.name: Return
moves.desc: This full-power attack grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Present
moves.desc: The user attacks by giving the target a gift with a hidden trap. It restores HP sometimes, however.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.desc: This full-power attack grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Safeguard
moves.desc: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.

moves.name: Pain Split
moves.desc: The user adds its HP to the target’s HP, then equally shares the combined HP with the target.

moves.name: Sacred Fire
moves.desc: The target is razed with a mystical fire of great intensity. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Magnitude
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it with a ground-shaking quake. Its power varies.

moves.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.desc: The user punches the target with full, concentrated power. This confuses the target if it hits.

moves.name: Megahorn
moves.desc: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

moves.name: Dragon Breath
moves.desc: The user exhales a mighty gust that inflicts damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Baton Pass
moves.desc: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

moves.name: Encore
moves.desc: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

moves.name: Pursuit
moves.desc: The power of this attack move is doubled if it's used on a target that's switching out of battle.

moves.name: Rapid Spin
moves.desc: A spin attack that can also eliminate such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also raises the user’s Speed stat.

moves.name: Sweet Scent
moves.desc: A sweet scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon’s evasiveness. It also lures wild Pokémon if used in grass, etc.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.desc: The target is slammed with a steel-hard tail. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Metal Claw
moves.desc: The target is raked with steel claws. This may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Vital Throw
moves.desc: The user attacks last. In return, this throw move never misses.

moves.name: Morning Sun
moves.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Synthesis
moves.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Moonlight
moves.desc: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.desc: A unique attack that varies in type depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Cross Chop
moves.desc: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Twister
moves.desc: The user whips up a vicious tornado to tear at opposing Pokémon. This may also make them flinch.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.desc: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves. It lowers the power of Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.desc: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves. It lowers the power of Water-type moves.

moves.name: Crunch
moves.desc: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Mirror Coat
moves.desc: A retaliation move that counters any special attack, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Psych Up
moves.desc: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.desc: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Ancient Power
moves.desc: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also raise all the user’s stats at once.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.desc: The user hurls a shadowy blob at the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Future Sight
moves.desc: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.desc: The user attacks with a punch that may lower the target’s Defense stat. It’s also one of the Pokétch’s hidden moves.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.desc: The user traps the target in a violent swirling whirlpool for four to five turns.

moves.name: Beat Up
moves.desc: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.

moves.name: Fake Out
moves.desc: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It only works the first turn each time the user enters battle.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.desc: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.

moves.name: Stockpile
moves.desc: The user charges up power and raises both its Defense and Sp. Def stats. The move can be used three times.

moves.name: Spit Up
moves.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is released at once in an attack. The more power is stored, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Swallow
moves.desc: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to heal its HP. Storing more power heals more HP.

moves.name: Heat Wave
moves.desc: The user attacks by exhaling hot breath on opposing Pokémon. This may also leave those Pokémon with a burn.

moves.name: Hail
moves.desc: The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns. It damages all Pokémon except Ice types.

moves.name: Torment
moves.desc: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.

moves.name: Flatter
moves.desc: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also raises the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Will-O-Wisp
moves.desc: The user shoots a sinister flame at the target to inflict a burn.

moves.name: Memento
moves.desc: The user faints when using this move. In return, this harshly lowers the target’s Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Facade
moves.desc: This attack move doubles its power if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.desc: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before it is used.

moves.name: Smelling Salts
moves.desc: This attack's power is doubled when used on a target with paralysis. This also cures the target's paralysis, however.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making all targets take aim only at the user.

moves.name: Nature Power
moves.desc: This attack makes use of nature’s power. Its effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Charge
moves.desc: The user boosts the power of the Electric move it uses on the next turn. This also raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.desc: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.desc: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally’s attack.

moves.name: Trick
moves.desc: The user catches the target off guard and swaps its held item with its own.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.desc: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target’s Ability.

moves.name: Wish
moves.desc: One turn after this move is used, the user’s or its replacement’s HP is restored by half the user’s max HP.

moves.name: Assist
moves.desc: The user hurriedly and randomly uses a move among those known by ally Pokémon.

moves.name: Ingrain
moves.desc: The user lays roots that restore its HP on every turn. Because it’s rooted, it can’t switch out.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with great power. However, this also lowers the user’s Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Magic Coat
moves.desc: Moves like Leech Seed and moves that inflict status conditions are blocked by a barrier and reflected back to the user of those moves.

moves.name: Recycle
moves.desc: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.

moves.name: Revenge
moves.desc: This attack move’s power is doubled if the user has been hurt by the opponent in the same turn.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.desc: The user attacks with a swift chop. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Yawn
moves.desc: The user lets loose a huge yawn that lulls the target into falling asleep on the next turn.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.desc: The user slaps down the target’s held item, and that item can’t be used in that battle. The move does more damage if the target has a held item.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.desc: This attack move cuts down the target’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Eruption
moves.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user’s HP, the lower the move’s power.

moves.name: Skill Swap
moves.desc: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.desc: If opposing Pokémon know any move also known by the user, they are prevented from using it.

moves.name: Refresh
moves.desc: The user rests to cure itself of poisoning, a burn, or paralysis.

moves.name: Grudge
moves.desc: If the user faints, the user’s grudge fully depletes the PP of the opponent’s move that knocked it out.

moves.name: Snatch
moves.desc: The user steals the effects of any attempts to use a healing or stat-changing move.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.desc: The additional effects of this attack depend upon where it was used.

moves.name: Dive
moves.desc: Diving on the first turn, the user floats up and attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Arm Thrust
moves.desc: The user lets loose a flurry of open-palmed arm thrusts that hit two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Camouflage
moves.desc: The user's type is changed depending on its environment, such as at water's edge, in grass, or in a cave.

moves.name: Tail Glow
moves.desc: The user stares at flashing lights to focus its mind, drastically raising its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Luster Purge
moves.desc: The user lets loose a damaging burst of light. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Mist Ball
moves.desc: A mist-like flurry of down envelops and damages the target. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Feather Dance
moves.desc: The user covers the target’s body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.

moves.name: Teeter Dance
moves.desc: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses the Pokémon around it.

moves.name: Blaze Kick
moves.desc: The user launches a kick that lands a critical hit more easily. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Mud Sport
moves.desc: The user kicks up mud on the battlefield. This weakens Electric-type moves for five turns.

moves.name: Ice Ball
moves.desc: The user attacks the target for five turns. The move's power increases each time it hits.

moves.name: Needle Arm
moves.desc: The user attacks by wildly swinging its thorny arms. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Slack Off
moves.desc: The user slacks off, restoring its own HP by up to half of its max HP.

moves.name: Hyper Voice
moves.desc: The user lets loose a horribly echoing shout with the power to inflict damage.

moves.name: Poison Fang
moves.desc: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.

moves.name: Crush Claw
moves.desc: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Blast Burn
moves.desc: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Hydro Cannon
moves.desc: The target is hit with a watery blast. The user can’t move on the next turn.

moves.name: Meteor Mash
moves.desc: The target is hit with a hard punch fired like a meteor. This may also raise the user’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Astonish
moves.desc: The user attacks the target while shouting in a startling fashion. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Weather Ball
moves.desc: This attack move varies in power and type depending on the weather.

moves.name: Aromatherapy
moves.desc: The user releases a soothing scent that heals all status conditions affecting the user’s party.

moves.name: Fake Tears
moves.desc: The user feigns crying to fluster the target, harshly lowering its Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Air Cutter
moves.desc: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Zing Zap
moves.desc: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target, giving it an electric shock. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Nature’s Madness
moves.desc: The user hits the target with the force of nature. It halves the target's HP.

moves.name: Multi-Attack
moves.desc: Cloaking itself in high energy, the user slams into the target. The memory held determines the move's type.

moves.name: 10,000,000 Volt Thunderbolt
moves.desc: The user, Pikachu wearing a cap, powers up a jolt of electricity using its Z-Power and unleashes it. Critical hits land more easily.

moves.name: Mind Blown
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it by causing its own head to explode. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Plasma Fists
moves.desc: The user attacks with electrically charged fists. This move changes Normal-type moves to Electric-type moves.

moves.name: Photon Geyser
moves.desc: The user attacks a target with a pillar of light. This move inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage—whichever stat is higher for the user.

moves.name: Light That Burns the Sky
moves.desc: This attack inflicts Attack or Sp. Atk damage— whichever stat is higher for the user, Necrozma. This move ignores the target's Ability.

moves.name: Searing Sunraze Smash
moves.desc: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Solgaleo, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target's Ability.

moves.name: Menacing Moonraze Maelstrom
moves.desc: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lunala, attacks the target with full force. This move can ignore the effect of the target's Ability.

moves.name: Let’s Snuggle Forever
moves.desc: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Mimikyu, punches the target with full force.

moves.name: Splintered Stormshards
moves.desc: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Lycanroc, attacks the target with full force. This move negates the effect on the battlefield.

moves.name: Clangorous Soulblaze
moves.desc: After obtaining Z-Power, the user, Kommo-o, attacks the opposing Pokémon with full force. This move boosts the user's stats.

moves.name: Zippy Zap
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with bursts of electricity at high speed. This move always goes first and results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Splishy Splash
moves.desc: The user charges a huge wave with electricity and hits the opposing Pokémon with the wave. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon with paralysis.

moves.name: Floaty Fall
moves.desc: The user floats in the air, and then dives at a steep angle to attack the target. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Pika Papow
moves.desc: The more Pikachu loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power. It never misses.

moves.name: Bouncy Bubble
moves.desc: The user attacks by shooting water bubbles at the target. It then absorbs water and restores its HP by half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Buzzy Buzz
moves.desc: The user shoots a jolt of electricity to attack the target. This also leaves the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Sizzly Slide
moves.desc: The user cloaks itself in fire and charges at the target. This also leaves the target with a burn.

moves.name: Glitzy Glow
moves.desc: The user bombards the target with telekinetic force. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon’s special moves.

moves.name: Baddy Bad
moves.desc: The user acts bad and attacks the target. A wondrous wall of light is put up to weaken the power of the opposing Pokémon’s physical moves.

moves.name: Sappy Seed
moves.desc: The user grows a gigantic stalk that scatters seeds to attack the target. The seeds drain the target’s HP every turn.

moves.name: Freezy Frost
moves.desc: The user attacks with a crystal made of cold frozen haze. It eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.

moves.name: Sparkly Swirl
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by wrapping it with a whirlwind of an overpowering scent. This also heals all status conditions of the user’s party.

moves.name: Veevee Volley
moves.desc: The more Eevee loves its Trainer, the greater the move’s power. It never misses.

moves.name: Double Iron Bash
moves.desc: The user rotates, centering the hex nut in its chest, and then strikes with its arms twice in a row. This may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Max Guard
moves.desc: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Dynamax Cannon
moves.desc: The user unleashes a strong beam from its core. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Snipe Shot
moves.desc: The user ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities that draw in moves, allowing this move to hit the chosen target.

moves.name: Jaw Lock
moves.desc: This move prevents the user and the target from switching out until either of them faints. The effect goes away if either of the Pokémon leaves the field.

moves.name: Stuff Cheeks
moves.desc: The user eats its held Berry, then sharply raises its Defense stat.

moves.name: No Retreat
moves.desc: This move raises all the user's stats but prevents the user from switching out or fleeing.

moves.name: Tar Shot
moves.desc: The user pours sticky tar over the target, lowering the target's Speed stat. The target becomes weaker to Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Magic Powder
moves.desc: The user scatters a cloud of magic powder that changes the target to Psychic type.

moves.name: Dragon Darts
moves.desc: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two targets, this move hits each target once.

moves.name: Teatime
moves.desc: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.

moves.name: Octolock
moves.desc: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target's Defense and Sp. Def every turn.

moves.name: Bolt Beak
moves.desc: The user stabs the target with its electrified beak. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

moves.name: Fishious Rend
moves.desc: The user rends the target with its hard gills. If the user attacks before the target, the power of this move is doubled.

moves.name: Court Change
moves.desc: With its mysterious power, the user swaps the effects on either side of the field.

moves.name: Max Flare
moves.desc: This is a Fire-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user intensifies the sun for five turns.

moves.name: Max Flutterby
moves.desc: This is a Bug-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Max Lightning
moves.desc: This is an Electric-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns.

moves.name: Max Strike
moves.desc: This is a Normal-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Max Knuckle
moves.desc: This is a Fighting-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Attack stats.

moves.name: Max Phantasm
moves.desc: This is a Ghost-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Max Hailstorm
moves.desc: This is an Ice-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a hailstorm lasting five turns.

moves.name: Max Ooze
moves.desc: This is a Poison-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Sp. Atk stats.

moves.name: Max Geyser
moves.desc: This is a Water-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns.

moves.name: Max Airstream
moves.desc: This is a Flying-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Speed stats.

moves.name: Max Starfall
moves.desc: This is a Fairy-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Misty Terrain for five turns.

moves.name: Max Wyrmwind
moves.desc: This is a Dragon-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Attack stat.

moves.name: Max Mindstorm
moves.desc: This is a Psychic-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Psychic Terrain for five turns.

moves.name: Max Rockfall
moves.desc: This is a Rock-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user summons a sandstorm lasting five turns.

moves.name: Max Quake
moves.desc: This is a Ground-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Max Darkness
moves.desc: This is a Dark-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Max Overgrowth
moves.desc: This is a Grass-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns.

moves.name: Max Steelspike
moves.desc: This is a Steel-type attack Dynamax Pokémon use. This raises ally Pokémon's Defense stats.

moves.name: Clangorous Soul
moves.desc: The user raises all its stats by using some of its HP.

moves.name: Body Press
moves.desc: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user’s Defense, the more damage it can inflict on the target.

moves.name: Decorate
moves.desc: The user sharply raises the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.

moves.name: Drum Beating
moves.desc: The user plays its drum, controlling the drum's roots to attack the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: Snap Trap
moves.desc: The user snares the target in a snap trap for four to five turns.

moves.name: Pyro Ball
moves.desc: The user attacks by igniting a small stone and launching it as a fiery ball at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Behemoth Blade
moves.desc: The user becomes a gigantic sword and cuts the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Behemoth Bash
moves.desc: The user becomes a gigantic shield and slams into the target. This move deals twice the damage if the target is Dynamaxed.

moves.name: Aura Wheel
moves.desc: Morpeko attacks and raises its Speed with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.

moves.name: Breaking Swipe
moves.desc: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.

moves.name: Branch Poke
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by poking it with a sharply pointed branch.

moves.name: Overdrive
moves.desc: The user attacks opposing Pokémon by twanging a guitar or bass guitar, causing a huge echo and strong vibration.

moves.name: Apple Acid
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Grav Apple
moves.desc: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Spirit Break
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with so much force that it could break the target's spirit. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Strange Steam
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by emitting steam. This may also confuse the target.

moves.name: Life Dew
moves.desc: The user scatters mysterious water around and restores the HP of itself and its ally Pokémon in the battle.

moves.name: Obstruct
moves.desc: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession. Direct contact harshly lowers the attacker's Defense stat.

moves.name: False Surrender
moves.desc: The user pretends to bow its head, but then it stabs the target with its disheveled hair. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Meteor Assault
moves.desc: The user attacks wildly with its thick leek. The user can't move on the next turn, because the force of this move makes it stagger.

moves.name: Eternabeam
moves.desc: This is Eternatus's most powerful attack in its original form. The user can't move on the next turn.

moves.name: Steel Beam
moves.desc: The user fires a beam of steel that it collected from its entire body. This also damages the user.

moves.name: Expanding Force
moves.desc: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. This move's power goes up and damages all opposing Pokémon on Psychic Terrain.

moves.name: Steel Roller
moves.desc: The user attacks while destroying the terrain. This move fails when the ground hasn't turned into a terrain.

moves.name: Scale Shot
moves.desc: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.

moves.name: Meteor Beam
moves.desc: In this two-turn attack, the user gathers space power and boosts its Sp. Atk stat, then attacks the target on the next turn.

moves.name: Shell Side Arm
moves.desc: This move inflicts physical or special damage, whichever will be more effective. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Misty Explosion
moves.desc: The user attacks everything around it and faints upon using this move. This move's power is increased on Misty Terrain.

moves.name: Grassy Glide
moves.desc: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.

moves.name: Rising Voltage
moves.desc: The user attacks with electric voltage rising from the ground. This move's power doubles when the target is on Electric Terrain.

moves.name: Terrain Pulse
moves.desc: The user utilizes the power of the terrain to attack. This move's type and power changes depending on the terrain when it's used.

moves.name: Skitter Smack
moves.desc: The user skitters behind the target to attack. This also lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Burning Jealousy
moves.desc: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.

moves.name: Lash Out
moves.desc: The user lashes out to vent its frustration toward the target. If the user's stats were lowered during this turn, the power of this move is doubled.

moves.name: Poltergeist
moves.desc: The user attacks the target by controlling the target's item. The move fails if the target doesn't have an item.

moves.name: Corrosive Gas
moves.desc: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.

moves.name: Coaching
moves.desc: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Flip Turn
moves.desc: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Triple Axel
moves.desc: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.

moves.name: Dual Wingbeat
moves.desc: The user slams the target with its wings. The target is hit twice in a row.

moves.name: Scorching Sands
moves.desc: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Jungle Healing
moves.desc: The user becomes one with the jungle, restoring HP and healing any status conditions of itself and its ally Pokémon in battle.

moves.name: Wicked Blow
moves.desc: The user, having mastered the Dark style, strikes the target with a fierce blow. This attack always results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Surging Strikes
moves.desc: The user, having mastered the Water style, strikes the target with a flowing motion three times in a row. This attack always results in a critical hit.

moves.name: Thunder Cage
moves.desc: The user traps the target in a cage of sparking electricity for four to five turns.

moves.name: Dragon Energy
moves.desc: Converting its life-force into power, the user attacks opposing Pokémon. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.

moves.name: Freezing Glare
moves.desc: The user shoots its psychic power from its eyes to attack. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Fiery Wrath
moves.desc: The user transforms its wrath into a fire-like aura to attack. This may also make opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Thunderous Kick
moves.desc: The user overwhelms the target with lightning-like movement before delivering a kick. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.

moves.name: Glacial Lance
moves.desc: The user attacks by hurling a blizzard-cloaked icicle lance at opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Astral Barrage
moves.desc: The user attacks by sending a frightful amount of small ghosts at opposing Pokémon.

moves.name: Eerie Spell
moves.desc: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also removes 3 PP from the target's last move.

mons.name: Bulbasaur
mons.dex: For some time after its birth, it grows by taking nourishment from the seed on its back.

mons.name: Ivysaur
mons.dex: When the bud on its back starts swelling, a sweet aroma wafts to indicate the flower’s coming bloom.

mons.name: Venusaur
mons.dex: After a rainy day, the flower on its back smells stronger. The scent attracts other Pokémon.

mons.name: Charmander
mons.dex: The fire on the tip of its tail is a measure of its life. If the Pokémon is healthy, its tail burns intensely.

mons.name: Charmeleon
mons.dex: In the rocky mountains where Charmeleon live, their fiery tails shine at night like stars.

mons.name: Charizard
mons.dex: It is said that Charizard’s fire burns hotter if it has experienced harsh battles.

mons.name: Squirtle
mons.dex: It hides in its shell to protect itself, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.

mons.name: Wartortle
mons.dex: It is said to live 10,000 years. Its furry tail is popular as a symbol of longevity.

mons.name: Blastoise
mons.dex: The jets of water it spouts from the rocket cannons on its shell can punch through thick steel.

mons.name: Caterpie
mons.dex: It releases a stench from its red antennae to repel enemies. It grows by molting repeatedly.

mons.name: Metapod
mons.dex: A steel-hard shell protects its tender body. The Pokémon quietly endures hardships while awaiting evolution.

mons.name: Butterfree
mons.dex: It loves the nectar of flowers and can locate flower patches that have even tiny amounts of pollen.

mons.name: Weedle
mons.dex: It eats its weight in leaves every day. It fends off attackers with the needle on its head.

mons.name: Kakuna
mons.dex: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.

mons.name: Beedrill
mons.dex: Its best attack involves flying around at high speed, striking with poison needles, then flying off.

mons.name: Pidgey
mons.dex: It is docile and prefers to avoid conflict. If disturbed, however, it can ferociously strike back.

mons.name: Pidgeotto
mons.dex: It flies over its wide territory in search of prey, downing it with its highly developed claws.

mons.name: Pidgeot
mons.dex: By flapping its wings with all its might, Pidgeot can make a gust of wind capable of bending tall trees.

mons.name: Rattata
mons.dex: It’s cautious in the extreme, and its hardy vitality lets it live in any kind of environment.

mons.name: Raticate
mons.dex: It whittles down its constantly growing fangs by gnawing on hard things. It can chew apart cinder block walls.

mons.name: Spearow
mons.dex: It flaps its small wings busily to fly. Using its beak, it searches in grass for prey.

mons.name: Fearow
mons.dex: It has the stamina to fly all day on its broad wings. It fights by using its sharp beak.

mons.name: Ekans
mons.dex: It sneaks through grass without making a sound and strikes unsuspecting prey from behind.

mons.name: Arbok
mons.dex: The pattern on its belly is for intimidation. It constricts foes while they are frozen in fear.

mons.name: Pikachu
mons.dex: It lives in forests with others. It stores electricity in the electric sacs on its cheeks.

mons.name: Raichu
mons.dex: It turns aggressive if it has too much electricity in its body. It discharges power through its tail.

mons.name: Sandshrew
mons.dex: To protect itself from attackers, it curls up into a ball. It lives in arid regions with minimal rainfall.

mons.name: Sandslash
mons.dex: It curls up, then rolls into foes with its back. Its sharp spines inflict severe damage.

mons.name: Nidoran♀
mons.dex: While this Pokémon does not prefer to fight, even one drop of the venom it secretes from its barbs can be fatal.

mons.name: Nidorina
mons.dex: When it senses danger, it raises all the barbs on its body. These barbs grow more slowly than Nidorino’s.

mons.name: Nidoqueen
mons.dex: Its entire body is armored with hard scales. It will protect the young in its burrow with its life.

mons.name: Nidoran♂
mons.dex: It scans its surroundings by raising its ears out of the grass. Its toxic horn is for protection.

mons.name: Nidorino
mons.dex: It has a violent disposition and stabs foes with its horn, which oozes venom upon impact.

mons.name: Nidoking
mons.dex: One swing of its mighty tail can snap a telephone pole as if it were a matchstick.

mons.name: Clefairy
mons.dex: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Clefable
mons.dex: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.

mons.name: Vulpix
mons.dex: It controls balls of fire. As it grows, its six tails split from their tips to make more tails.

mons.name: Ninetales
mons.dex: Its nine tails are said to be imbued with a mystic power. The Pokémon is said to live for 1,000 years.

mons.name: Jigglypuff
mons.dex: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

mons.name: Wigglytuff
mons.dex: Its fine fur feels sublime to the touch. It can expand its body by inhaling air.

mons.name: Zubat
mons.dex: Even though it has no eyes, it can sense obstacles using ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Golbat
mons.dex: It loves the blood of humans and Pokémon. It flies around at night in search of neck veins.

mons.name: Oddish
mons.dex: It often plants its root feet in the ground during the day and sows seeds as it walks about at night.

mons.name: Gloom
mons.dex: The nectar it drools from its mouth smells so atrocious that it can make noses curl from more than a mile away.

mons.name: Vileplume
mons.dex: Its petals are the largest in the world. As it walks, it scatters extremely allergenic pollen.

mons.name: Paras
mons.dex: Mushrooms named tochukaso grow on its back. They grow along with the host Paras.

mons.name: Parasect
mons.dex: Parasect is controlled by a mushroom that has grown larger than its host’s body. The Pokémon scatters poisonous spores.

mons.name: Venonat
mons.dex: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

mons.name: Venomoth
mons.dex: It flutters its wings to scatter dustlike scales. The scales leach toxins if they contact skin.

mons.name: Diglett
mons.dex: This Pokémon lives underground. Because of its dark habitat, it is repelled by bright sunlight.

mons.name: Dugtrio
mons.dex: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

mons.name: Meowth
mons.dex: It is nocturnal by nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter as brightly as the shiny object.

mons.name: Persian
mons.dex: It is a very haughty Pokémon. Among fans of Persian, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

mons.name: Psyduck
mons.dex: If its usual headache worsens, it starts exhibiting odd powers. It can’t remember doing so, however.

mons.name: Golduck
mons.dex: This Pokémon lives in lakes. It swims faster than any world-class swimmer.

mons.name: Mankey
mons.dex: It lives in treetop colonies. If one member of the group becomes enraged, the whole colony rampages for no reason.

mons.name: Primeape
mons.dex: It becomes angry if it sees an opponent’s eyes and gets angrier if the opponent runs. Even after it beats the opponent, it is still angry.

mons.name: Growlithe
mons.dex: It is a Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

mons.name: Arcanine
mons.dex: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

mons.name: Poliwag
mons.dex: Its skin is so thin, its internal organs are visible. It has trouble walking on its newly grown feet.

mons.name: Poliwhirl
mons.dex: The spiral pattern on its belly subtly undulates. Staring at it gradually causes drowsiness.

mons.name: Poliwrath
mons.dex: With its extremely tough muscles, it could keep swimming in the Pacific Ocean without resting.

mons.name: Abra
mons.dex: It sleeps for 18 hours a day. Even when awake, it teleports itself while remaining seated.

mons.name: Kadabra
mons.dex: If one is nearby, an eerie shadow appears on TV screens. Seeing the shadow is said to bring bad luck.

mons.name: Alakazam
mons.dex: Its superb memory lets it recall everything it has experienced from birth. Its IQ exceeds 5,000.

mons.name: Machop
mons.dex: It hefts a Graveler repeatedly to strengthen its entire body. It uses every type of martial arts.

mons.name: Machoke
mons.dex: Machoke’s boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.

mons.name: Machamp
mons.dex: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.

mons.name: Bellsprout
mons.dex: It prefers hot and humid environments. It is quick at capturing prey with its vines.

mons.name: Weepinbell
mons.dex: This Pokémon has the appearance of a plant. It captures unwary prey by dousing them with a toxic powder.

mons.name: Victreebel
mons.dex: In its mouth, it pools a fragrant nectar-like fluid. The fluid is really an acid that dissolves anything.

mons.name: Tentacool
mons.dex: Its body is mostly composed of water. It shoots strange beams from its crystal-like eyes.

mons.name: Tentacruel
mons.dex: With 80 tentacles for ensnaring victims, it prevents escape until the prey is weakened by poison.

mons.name: Geodude
mons.dex: Many live on mountain trails and remain half-buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Graveler
mons.dex: Graveler make their homes on sheer cliff faces that have numerous holes in them.

mons.name: Golem
mons.dex: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulder-like body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.

mons.name: Ponyta
mons.dex: About an hour after birth, Ponyta’s fiery mane and tail grow out, giving the Pokémon an impressive appearance.

mons.name: Rapidash
mons.dex: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

mons.name: Slowpoke
mons.dex: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

mons.name: Slowbro
mons.dex: Though usually dim-witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

mons.name: Magnemite
mons.dex: The units at its sides generate electromagnetic waves that keep it airborne. It feeds on electricity.

edges: Level Up in Magnetic Field / Use Thunder Stone

mons.name: Magneton
mons.dex: A Magneton is actually three Magnemite linked by magnetism. A group of these Pokémon can set off a magnetic storm.

edges: Level Up in Magnetic Field / Use Thunder Stone

mons.name: Farfetch’d
mons.dex: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

mons.name: Doduo
mons.dex: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.

mons.name: Dodrio
mons.dex: When Doduo evolves into this odd breed, one of its heads splits into two. This Pokémon runs at nearly 40 mph.

mons.name: Seel
mons.dex: This Pokémon lives on icebergs. It uses the sharp point on its head to break up ice as it swims in the sea.

mons.name: Dewgong
mons.dex: In snow, the pure white coat covering its body obscures it from predators.

mons.name: Grimer
mons.dex: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

mons.name: Muk
mons.dex: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid kills plants and trees immediately upon contact.

mons.name: Shellder
mons.dex: It swims backward by opening and closing its two shells. Its large tongue is always kept hanging out.

mons.name: Cloyster
mons.dex: It fights by keeping its shell tightly shut for protection and by shooting spikes to repel foes.

mons.name: Gastly
mons.dex: This Pokémon’s body is 95 percent made up of gases. The Pokémon can be blown away by strong gusts of wind.

mons.name: Haunter
mons.dex: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.

mons.name: Gengar
mons.dex: It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

mons.name: Onix
mons.dex: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

mons.name: Drowzee
mons.dex: It can tell what people are dreaming by sniffing with its big nose. It loves fun dreams.

mons.name: Hypno
mons.dex: Seeing its swinging pendulum can induce sleep in three seconds, even in someone who just woke up.

mons.name: Krabby
mons.dex: It lives in burrows dug on sandy beaches. Its pincers fully grow back if they are lost in battle.

mons.name: Kingler
mons.dex: The larger pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, it is so heavy, it is difficult to aim.

mons.name: Voltorb
mons.dex: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

mons.name: Electrode
mons.dex: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

mons.name: Exeggcute
mons.dex: Its six eggs converse using telepathy. They can quickly gather if they become separated.

mons.name: Exeggutor
mons.dex: It is called the Walking Jungle. If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

mons.name: Cubone
mons.dex: When it thinks of its dead mother, it cries. Its crying makes the skull it wears rattle hollowly.

mons.name: Marowak
mons.dex: The bones it uses have been in its possession since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.

mons.name: Hitmonlee
mons.dex: Its legs can stretch to double their length. First-time foes are startled by Hitmonlee’s extensible reach.

mons.name: Hitmonchan
mons.dex: When Hitmonchan twists its arm while throwing a punch, the blow will pulverize even concrete. The Pokémon rests after three minutes of fighting.

mons.name: Lickitung
mons.dex: Instead of its hands, it uses its tongue, which can stretch to twice this Pokémon’s height. Lickitung’s sticky saliva grips anything.

mons.name: Koffing
mons.dex: Lighter-than-air gases in its body keep it aloft. The gases not only smell; they are also explosive.

mons.name: Weezing
mons.dex: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.

mons.name: Rhyhorn
mons.dex: Its body is clad in a thick hide, and its tackles topple buildings. Unfortunately, it is not smart.

mons.name: Rhydon
mons.dex: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.

mons.name: Chansey
mons.dex: It is said to deliver happiness. Being compassionate, it shares its eggs with injured people.

mons.name: Tangela
mons.dex: It is shrouded by blue vines. No one has seen the face hidden behind this growth of vines.

mons.name: Kangaskhan
mons.dex: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

mons.name: Horsea
mons.dex: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits black ink and flees.

mons.name: Seadra
mons.dex: Its spines provide protection. Its fins and bones are prized as traditional medicine ingredients.

mons.name: Goldeen
mons.dex: It swims elegantly by flittering its tail fin as if it were a dress. It has the look of a queen.

mons.name: Seaking
mons.dex: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. The Pokémon defends its eggs with its life.

mons.name: Staryu
mons.dex: If Staryu’s body is damaged, it will regenerate as long as the red core remains. The core flashes at midnight.

mons.name: Starmie
mons.dex: At the center of its body is a red core that sends mysterious radio signals into the night sky.

mons.name: Mr. Mime
mons.dex: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

mons.name: Scyther
mons.dex: It is nearly impossible to parry its attacking scythes. Its movements are like a ninja’s.

mons.name: Jynx
mons.dex: Its cries sound like human speech. However, it is impossible to tell what it is trying to say.

mons.name: Electabuzz
mons.dex: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.

mons.name: Magmar
mons.dex: It was born in the crater of a volcano. Its body is covered with flames that shimmer like the sun.

mons.name: Pinsir
mons.dex: It grips prey with its pincers until the prey is torn apart. What it can’t tear, it tosses far away.

mons.name: Tauros
mons.dex: Once it takes aim at its prey, it makes a headlong charge. It is famous for its violent nature.

mons.name: Magikarp
mons.dex: It is said to be the world’s weakest Pokémon. No one knows why it has managed to survive.

mons.name: Gyarados
mons.dex: Once Gyarados appears, its rage never settles until the Pokémon has razed the fields and mountains around it.

mons.name: Lapras
mons.dex: It loves crossing the sea with people and Pokémon on its back. It understands human speech.

mons.name: Ditto
mons.dex: It has the ability to reconstitute its entire cellular structure to transform into whatever it sees.

mons.name: Eevee
mons.dex: It is a rare Pokémon that adapts to harsh environments by changing its appearance and capabilities when it evolves.

mons.name: Porygon
mons.dex: The world’s first artificially created Pokémon. It can travel through electronic space.

mons.name: Omanyte
mons.dex: It’s a Pokémon that was resurrected from a fossil using modern science. It swam in ancient seas.

mons.name: Omastar
mons.dex: It is thought that this Pokémon became extinct because its spiral shell grew too large.

mons.name: Kabuto
mons.dex: It is thought to have inhabited beaches 300 million years ago. It is protected by a sturdy shell.

mons.name: Kabutops
mons.dex: It is thought that this Pokémon came onto land because its prey adapted to life on land.

mons.name: Aerodactyl
mons.dex: It’s a Pokémon that roamed the skies in the dinosaur era. Its teeth are like saw blades.

mons.name: Snorlax
mons.dex: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.

mons.name: Articuno
mons.dex: This legendary bird Pokémon can create blizzards by freezing moisture in the air.

mons.name: Zapdos
mons.dex: This legendary Pokémon is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.

mons.name: Moltres
mons.dex: It is one of the legendary bird Pokémon. Its appearance is said to indicate the coming of spring.

mons.name: Dratini
mons.dex: It is called the Mirage Pokémon because so few have seen it, but its shed skin has been found.

mons.name: Dragonair
mons.dex: If its body takes on an aura, the weather changes instantly. It is said to live in seas and lakes.

mons.name: Dragonite
mons.dex: It is said to make its home somewhere in the sea. It guides wrecked ships to shore.

mons.name: Mewtwo
mons.dex: Mewtwo was created by recombining Mew’s genes. It’s said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

mons.name: Mew
mons.dex: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.

mons.name: Chikorita
mons.dex: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the air’s temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.

mons.name: Bayleef
mons.dex: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.

mons.name: Meganium
mons.dex: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.

mons.name: Cyndaquil
mons.dex: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.

mons.name: Quilava
mons.dex: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns stronger as it prepares to fight.

mons.name: Typhlosion
mons.dex: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.

mons.name: Totodile
mons.dex: It has a habit of biting everything with its well-developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.

mons.name: Croconaw
mons.dex: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.

mons.name: Feraligatr
mons.dex: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

mons.name: Sentret
mons.dex: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.

mons.name: Furret
mons.dex: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.

mons.name: Hoothoot
mons.dex: It always stands on one foot. Even when attacked, it does not brace itself using both feet.

mons.name: Noctowl
mons.dex: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.

mons.name: Ledyba
mons.dex: It’s so timid that it can’t move unless it’s with a swarm. It conveys its feelings through scent.

mons.name: Ledian
mons.dex: It uses starlight as energy. When more stars appear at night, the patterns on its back grow larger.

mons.name: Spinarak
mons.dex: It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong thread. It waits motionlessly for prey to arrive.

mons.name: Ariados
mons.dex: It attaches silk to its prey and sets it free. Later, it tracks the silk to the prey and its friends.

mons.name: Crobat
mons.dex: Having four wings enables it to fly faster and more quietly. It turns active when the night comes.

mons.name: Chinchou
mons.dex: It discharges positive and negative electricity from the tips of its antennae to shock its foes.

mons.name: Lanturn
mons.dex: Lanturn’s light can shine up from great depths. It is nicknamed the Deep-Sea Star.

mons.name: Pichu
mons.dex: The electric sacs on its cheeks are still small. They cannot store much electricity yet.

mons.name: Cleffa
mons.dex: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.

mons.name: Igglybuff
mons.dex: It has a soft and bouncy body. Once it starts bouncing, it becomes impossible to stop.

mons.name: Togepi
mons.dex: Its shell is said to be stuffed with happiness that it shares with kindhearted people.

mons.name: Togetic
mons.dex: It is said to appear in front of kindly people to scatter a glowing down called joy dust.

mons.name: Natu
mons.dex: It picks food from cactus plants, deftly avoiding buds and spines. It seems to skip about to move.

mons.name: Xatu
mons.dex: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.

mons.name: Mareep
mons.dex: Its fluffy coat doubles in size when static electricity builds up. Touching it can be shocking.

mons.name: Flaaffy
mons.dex: If its coat becomes fully charged with electricity, its tail lights up. Flaaffy can fire hair that zaps on impact.

mons.name: Ampharos
mons.dex: The tip of its tail shines brightly. In the olden days, people sent signals using the light from this Pokémon’s tail.

mons.name: Bellossom
mons.dex: When the heavy rainfall season ends, it is drawn out by warm sunlight to dance in the open.

mons.name: Marill
mons.dex: Using its tail as a float, it dives underwater. It likes eating plants that grow in riverbeds.

mons.name: Azumarill
mons.dex: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.

mons.name: Sudowoodo
mons.dex: Though it looks like a tree, its body is actually more like rock or stone. The Pokémon is very weak to water.

mons.name: Politoed
mons.dex: A group of Poliwag and Poliwhirl will form with a Politoed as the leader. Politoed’s cries make the Pokémon of the group obey.

mons.name: Hoppip
mons.dex: They are blown adrift by winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.

mons.name: Skiploom
mons.dex: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.

mons.name: Jumpluff
mons.dex: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.

mons.name: Aipom
mons.dex: It uses its tail to pluck fruits that are out of reach. Its tail is more adept than its real hands.

mons.name: Sunkern
mons.dex: They may suddenly fall out of the sky in the morning. In the year following a cold summer, their population explodes.

mons.name: Sunflora
mons.dex: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.

mons.name: Yanma
mons.dex: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without the Pokémon moving its head. It won’t miss prey— even those behind it.

mons.name: Wooper
mons.dex: It lives in cold water, half burying itself in mud at the bottom to sleep.

mons.name: Quagsire
mons.dex: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river’s bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.

mons.name: Espeon
mons.dex: Its fur has the look and feel of velvet. The orb on its forehead glows when it uses psychic power.
