mons.dex: It is believed that seeing this Pokémon at night will bring about ominous occurrences.

mons.name: Slowking
mons.dex: Being bitten by Shellder gave it intelligence comparable to that of internationally recognized scientists.

mons.name: Misdreavus
mons.dex: It loves to sneak up on people late at night and startle them with its shrieking cry.

mons.name: Unown A Form
mons.dex: Because the Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether written language or Unown came first.

mons.name: Wobbuffet
mons.dex: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. This behavior is said to be proof that its tail hides a secret.

mons.name: Girafarig
mons.dex: Its tail has a separate small brain. The tail bites to repel any foe trying to sneak up on the Pokémon from behind.

mons.name: Pineco
mons.dex: It looks just like a pinecone. Its shell protects it from bird Pokémon that peck it by mistake.

mons.name: Forretress
mons.dex: It is encased in a steel shell. Forretress’s eyes peer out, but what lies within this Pokémon’s shell is unknown.

mons.name: Dunsparce
mons.dex: It digs into the ground with its tail and makes a mazelike nest. It can fly just a little.

mons.name: Gligar
mons.dex: It sails on the winds with its limbs extended to strike from the sky. It aims for the prey’s face.

mons.name: Steelix
mons.dex: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

mons.name: Snubbull
mons.dex: Small Pokémon flee from its scary face. It is, however, considered by many people to be cute.

mons.name: Granbull
mons.dex: It is timid in spite of its looks. If it becomes enraged, however, it will strike with its huge fangs.

mons.name: Qwilfish
mons.dex: It shoots the poison spikes on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

mons.name: Scizor
mons.dex: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

mons.name: Shuckle
mons.dex: It stores berries in its shell. The berries mix with its body fluids to become delicious juices.

mons.name: Heracross
mons.dex: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It’s strong enough to hurl foes.

mons.name: Sneasel
mons.dex: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.

mons.name: Teddiursa
mons.dex: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.

mons.name: Ursaring
mons.dex: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

mons.name: Slugma
mons.dex: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.

mons.name: Magcargo
mons.dex: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Flames burst from gaps in its shell made of hardened magma.

mons.name: Swinub
mons.dex: It loves eating mushrooms that grow under dead grass. It also finds hot springs while foraging.

mons.name: Piloswine
mons.dex: Its shaggy coat makes it unable to see. It checks surroundings with its sensitive nose instead.

mons.name: Corsola
mons.dex: Many live in the clean seas of the south. They apparently can’t live in polluted waters.

mons.name: Remoraid
mons.dex: It squirts water forcefully from its mouth to shoot down flying prey.

mons.name: Octillery
mons.dex: It lives in the gaps of boulders and in holes on the seafloor. Its suction cups grip prey tightly.

mons.name: Delibird
mons.dex: It carries food rolled up in its tail. It has a habit of sharing food with people lost in the mountains.

mons.name: Mantine
mons.dex: When the waves are calm, one may encounter a swarm of Mantine swimming as if they are in flight.

mons.name: Skarmory
mons.dex: Skarmory is clad entirely in ironhard armor. It flies at speeds over 180 mph.

mons.name: Houndour
mons.dex: It conveys its feelings using different cries. It works in a pack to cleverly take down prey.

mons.name: Houndoom
mons.dex: Long ago, people imagined its eerie howls to be the call of the grim reaper.

mons.name: Kingdra
mons.dex: It lives in caves on the seafloor and creates giant whirlpools every time it moves.

mons.name: Phanpy
mons.dex: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.

mons.name: Donphan
mons.dex: It attacks by curling up and rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.

mons.name: Porygon2
mons.dex: With planetary development software installed, it became capable of working in space.

mons.name: Stantler
mons.dex: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

mons.name: Smeargle
mons.dex: It marks its territory by using its tail like a paintbrush. There are more than 5,000 different marks.

mons.name: Tyrogue
mons.dex: It is famous for its eagerness to fight and always nurses injuries from challenging larger foes.

mons.name: Hitmontop
mons.dex: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by a factor of 10.

mons.name: Smoochum
mons.dex: It tests everything by touching with its lips, which remember what it likes and dislikes.

mons.name: Elekid
mons.dex: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can’t store the energy it makes.

mons.name: Magby
mons.dex: Its body temperature is around 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit. It is healthy if it is exhaling yellow flames.

mons.name: Miltank
mons.dex: It is said that kids who drink Miltank’s milk grow up to become hearty, healthy adults.

mons.name: Blissey
mons.dex: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

mons.name: Raikou
mons.dex: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.

mons.name: Entei
mons.dex: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.

mons.name: Suicune
mons.dex: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.

mons.name: Larvitar
mons.dex: This Pokémon eats soil. Once it has eaten a large mountain, it goes to sleep so it can grow.

mons.name: Pupitar
mons.dex: Its body is as hard as bedrock. By venting pressurized gas, it can launch itself like a rocket.

mons.name: Tyranitar
mons.dex: If it rampages, it knocks down mountains and buries rivers. Maps must be redrawn afterward.

mons.name: Lugia
mons.dex: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

mons.name: Ho-Oh
mons.dex: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.

mons.name: Celebi
mons.dex: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.

mons.name: Treecko
mons.dex: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny hooks, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.

mons.name: Grovyle
mons.dex: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.

mons.name: Sceptile
mons.dex: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.

mons.name: Torchic
mons.dex: A fire burns inside it, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.

mons.name: Combusken
mons.dex: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.

mons.name: Blaziken
mons.dex: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.

mons.name: Mudkip
mons.dex: Using the fin on its head, Mudkip senses the flow of water to keep track of what’s going on around it. Mudkip has the strength to heft boulders.

mons.name: Marshtomp
mons.dex: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.

mons.name: Swampert
mons.dex: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.

mons.name: Poochyena
mons.dex: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.

mons.name: Mightyena
mons.dex: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.

mons.name: Zigzagoon
mons.dex: It walks in zigzag fashion. It’s good at finding items in the grass and even in the ground.

mons.name: Linoone
mons.dex: It charges prey at speeds over 60 mph. However, because it can only run straight, it often fails.

mons.name: Wurmple
mons.dex: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.

mons.name: Silcoon
mons.dex: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.

mons.name: Beautifly
mons.dex: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.

mons.name: Cascoon
mons.dex: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.

mons.name: Dustox
mons.dex: Dustox are nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.

mons.name: Lotad
mons.dex: It looks like an aquatic plant and serves as a ferry for Pokémon that can’t swim.

mons.name: Lombre
mons.dex: It has a mischievous spirit. If it spots an angler, it will tug on the fishing line to interfere.

mons.name: Ludicolo
mons.dex: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can’t help breaking out into a dance.

mons.name: Seedot
mons.dex: When it dangles from a tree branch, it looks just like an acorn. It enjoys scaring other Pokémon that try to peck at it.

mons.name: Nuzleaf
mons.dex: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in the forest.

mons.name: Shiftry
mons.dex: By flapping its leafy fans, it can whip up gusts of 100 feet per second that can level houses.

mons.name: Taillow
mons.dex: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.

mons.name: Swellow
mons.dex: It circles the sky in search of prey and dives sharply to catch its target.

mons.name: Wingull
mons.dex: It makes its nest on steep sea cliffs. Riding updrafts, it soars to great heights.

mons.name: Pelipper
mons.dex: It dips its large bill in the sea, then scoops up numerous prey along with water.

mons.name: Ralts
mons.dex: It uses the horns on its head to sense human emotions. It is said to appear in front of cheerful people.

mons.name: Kirlia
mons.dex: It is highly perceptive of its Trainer’s feelings. It dances when it is feeling happy.

mons.name: Gardevoir
mons.dex: It will try to guard its trusted Trainer with its life. It has the ability to see the future.

mons.name: Surskit
mons.dex: It appears as if it is skating on water. It draws prey in with a sweet scent released from the tip of its head.

mons.name: Masquerain
mons.dex: Its antennae have eye patterns on them. Its four wings enable it to hover and fly in any direction.

mons.name: Shroomish
mons.dex: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over the body if inhaled.

mons.name: Breloom
mons.dex: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.

mons.name: Slakoth
mons.dex: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.

mons.name: Vigoroth
mons.dex: Its heart beats at 10 times its previous rate, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.

mons.name: Slaking
mons.dex: It is the world’s laziest Pokémon. When it is lounging, it is actually saving energy for striking back.

mons.name: Nincada
mons.dex: It grows underground, sensing its surroundings using antennae instead of its virtually blind eyes.

mons.name: Ninjask
mons.dex: Because they move so quickly, they sometimes become unseeable. They congregate around tree sap.

mons.name: Shedinja
mons.dex: It is a discarded bug shell that came to life. Peering into the crack on its back is said to steal one’s spirit.

mons.name: Whismur
mons.dex: Usually, its cries are like quiet murmurs. If frightened, it shrieks at the same volume as a jet plane.

mons.name: Loudred
mons.dex: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

mons.name: Exploud
mons.dex: Its howls can be heard over six miles away. It emits all sorts of noises from the ports on its body.

mons.name: Makuhita
mons.dex: It toughens its body by slamming into thick trees. Many snapped trees can be found near its nest.

mons.name: Hariyama
mons.dex: It loves to match power with big-bodied Pokémon. It can send a truck flying with its arm thrusts.

mons.name: Azurill
mons.dex: It’s a Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

mons.name: Nosepass
mons.dex: Its nose is a magnet. As a result, this Pokémon always keeps its face pointing north.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Skitty
mons.dex: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in circles, chasing its own tail.

mons.name: Delcatty
mons.dex: It is highly popular among Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.

mons.name: Sableye
mons.dex: It hides in the darkness of caves. Its diet of gems has transformed its eyes into gemstones.

mons.name: Mawile
mons.dex: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.

mons.name: Aron
mons.dex: It usually lives deep in mountains. But when it’s hungry, it shows up at the foot of the mountains and eats railroad tracks and cars.

mons.name: Lairon
mons.dex: For food, it digs up iron ore. It smashes its steely body against others to fight over territory.

mons.name: Aggron
mons.dex: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.

mons.name: Meditite
mons.dex: It meditates in order to build up its mental energy. It’s said to eat just one Berry a day.

mons.name: Medicham
mons.dex: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.

mons.name: Electrike
mons.dex: Using electricity stored in its fur, it stimulates its muscles to heighten its reaction speed.

mons.name: Manectric
mons.dex: It discharges electricity from its mane. The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from which to drop lightning bolts.

mons.name: Plusle
mons.dex: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.

mons.name: Minun
mons.dex: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.

mons.name: Volbeat
mons.dex: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.

mons.name: Illumise
mons.dex: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.

mons.name: Roselia
mons.dex: Roselia raised on clean drinking water are known to grow vividly colored flowers.

mons.name: Gulpin
mons.dex: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.

mons.name: Swalot
mons.dex: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.

mons.name: Carvanha
mons.dex: They swarm any foe that invades their territory. Their sharp fangs can tear out boat hulls.

mons.name: Sharpedo
mons.dex: Its fangs rip through sheet iron. It swims at 75 mph and is known as the Bully of the Sea.

mons.name: Wailmer
mons.dex: On sunny days, it lands on beaches to bounce like a ball and play. It spouts water from its nostrils.

mons.name: Wailord
mons.dex: It’s the biggest of all Pokémon. It can dive to a depth of almost 10,000 feet on only one breath.

mons.name: Numel
mons.dex: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing Numel down.

mons.name: Camerupt
mons.dex: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.

mons.name: Torkoal
mons.dex: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is in a tough situation.

mons.name: Spoink
mons.dex: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.

mons.name: Grumpig
mons.dex: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.

mons.name: Spinda
mons.dex: No two Spinda have the same pattern of spots. Their tottering steps hinder the aim of foes.

mons.name: Trapinch
mons.dex: It makes a conical pit in desert sand and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.

mons.name: Vibrava
mons.dex: It violently shudders its wings, generating ultrasonic waves to induce headaches in people.

mons.name: Flygon
mons.dex: It whips up sandstorms with powerful flaps of its wings. It is known as the Desert Spirit.

mons.name: Cacnea
mons.dex: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.

mons.name: Cacturne
mons.dex: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.

mons.name: Swablu
mons.dex: Its wings are like cotton tufts. If it perches on someone’s head, it looks like a cotton hat.

mons.name: Altaria
mons.dex: It looks like a fluffy cloud when it is in flight. It hums with its soprano voice.

mons.name: Zangoose
mons.dex: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its greatest weapons.

mons.name: Seviper
mons.dex: For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.

mons.name: Lunatone
mons.dex: It becomes active on nights with a full moon, so it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Solrock
mons.dex: This new Pokémon species is rumored to be an avatar of the sun. The Pokémon gives off light while spinning.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Barboach
mons.dex: It coats its entire body with a slimy fluid so it can squirm and slip away if grabbed.

mons.name: Whiscash
mons.dex: It is very territorial. It repels foes by setting off tremors that extend over a three-mile radius.

mons.name: Corphish
mons.dex: Its hardy vitality enables it to adapt to any environment. Its pincers will never release prey.

mons.name: Crawdaunt
mons.dex: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.

mons.name: Baltoy
mons.dex: It moves by spinning on its foot. It is a rare Pokémon that was discovered in ancient ruins.

mons.name: Claydol
mons.dex: An ancient clay figurine was exposed to a mysterious ray of light, and it came to life as a Pokémon.

mons.name: Lileep
mons.dex: It lived on the seafloor 100 million years ago and was reanimated scientifically.

mons.name: Cradily
mons.dex: It lives in the shallows of warm seas. When the tide goes out, it digs up prey from beaches.

mons.name: Anorith
mons.dex: This Pokémon ancestor was reanimated from a fossil. It lived in the sea and hunted with its claws.

mons.name: Armaldo
mons.dex: It went ashore after evolving. Its entire body is clad in a sturdy armor.

mons.name: Feebas
mons.dex: They are famous for their shabby appearance. Although populous, they tend to cluster in set locations.

mons.name: Milotic
mons.dex: When people bicker, it is said to arise from the depths of lakes to becalm violent hearts.

mons.name: Castform Normal
mons.dex: Its appearance changes with the weather. Recently, its molecules were found to be just like water.

mons.name: Kecleon
mons.dex: It can freely change its body’s color. The zigzag pattern on its belly doesn’t change, however.

mons.name: Shuppet
mons.dex: They love vengeful emotions and hang in rows under the eaves of houses where vengeful people live.

mons.name: Banette
mons.dex: A doll bore a grudge over being junked, and it became a Pokémon. It seeks the child that disowned it.

mons.name: Duskull
mons.dex: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever the prey goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

mons.name: Dusclops
mons.dex: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.

mons.name: Tropius
mons.dex: Because it continually ate only its favorite fruit, the fruit started growing around its neck.

mons.name: Chimecho
mons.dex: To knock foes flying, it makes the air shudder with its cries. It converses using seven cries.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Absol
mons.dex: It senses coming disasters and appears before people only to warn them of impending danger.

mons.name: Wynaut
mons.dex: They grow strong by pushing up against one another en masse. They love eating sweet fruit.

mons.name: Snorunt
mons.dex: In some snowy lands, certain folklore says a house will prosper if a Snorunt lives there.

mons.name: Glalie
mons.dex: To protect itself, it clad its body in an armor of ice, made by freezing moisture in the air.

mons.name: Spheal
mons.dex: It rolls across ice floes to reach shore because its body is poorly shaped for swimming.

mons.name: Sealeo
mons.dex: It habitually spins things on its nose. By doing so, it learns textures and odors.

mons.name: Walrein
mons.dex: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold but also enemy attacks.

mons.name: Clamperl
mons.dex: It makes a single pearl during its lifetime. The pearl is said to amplify psychic power.

mons.name: Huntail
mons.dex: It lives deep in the sea. With a tail shaped like a small fish, it attracts unsuspecting prey.

mons.name: Gorebyss
mons.dex: It lives at the bottom of the sea. In the springtime, its pink body turns more vivid for some reason.

mons.name: Relicanth
mons.dex: This rare Pokémon was discovered during a deep-sea exploration. It has not changed in over 100 million years.

mons.name: Luvdisc
mons.dex: It lives in warm seas. It is said that couples who find this Pokémon will be blessed with eternal love.

mons.name: Bagon
mons.dex: Dreaming of one day flying, it practices by leaping off cliffs every day.

mons.name: Shelgon
mons.dex: Within its rugged shell, its cells have begun changing. The shell peels off the instant the Pokémon evolves.

mons.name: Salamence
mons.dex: As a result of its long-held dream of flying, its cellular structure changed, and wings grew out.

mons.name: Beldum
mons.dex: They converse with one another by using magnetic pulses. In a swarm, they move in perfect unison.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Metang
mons.dex: It is formed by two Beldum joining together. Its steel body won’t be scratched if it collides with a jet.

mons.name: Metagross
mons.dex: Metang combined to form it. With four brains, it has the intelligence of a supercomputer.

mons.name: Regirock
mons.dex: Its entire body is made of rock. If any part chips off in battle, Regirock attaches rocks to repair itself.

mons.name: Regice
mons.dex: Its body is made of ice from the ice age. It controls frigid air of −328 degrees Fahrenheit.

mons.name: Registeel
mons.dex: Tempered by pressure underground over tens of thousands of years, its body cannot be scratched.

mons.name: Latias
mons.dex: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.

mons.name: Latios
mons.dex: It is a highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its forelegs in flight, it can overtake jet planes.

mons.name: Kyogre
mons.dex: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.

mons.name: Groudon
mons.dex: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.

mons.name: Rayquaza
mons.dex: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.

mons.name: Jirachi
mons.dex: It is said to wake up for just seven days every 1,000 years and use its power to grant any wish.

mons.name: Deoxys Normal Forme
mons.dex: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteorite underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.

mons.name: Turtwig
mons.dex: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

mons.name: Grotle
mons.dex: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe the trees on its shell.

mons.name: Torterra
mons.dex: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

mons.name: Chimchar
mons.dex: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

mons.name: Monferno
mons.dex: To intimidate attackers, it expands the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

mons.name: Infernape
mons.dex: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

mons.name: Piplup
mons.dex: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

mons.name: Prinplup
mons.dex: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

mons.name: Empoleon
mons.dex: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

mons.name: Starly
mons.dex: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

mons.name: Staravia
mons.dex: They fly around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon, moving together in huge flocks.

mons.name: Staraptor
mons.dex: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger than itself.

mons.name: Bidoof
mons.dex: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

mons.name: Bibarel
mons.dex: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

mons.name: Kricketot
mons.dex: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

mons.name: Kricketune
mons.dex: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

mons.name: Shinx
mons.dex: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

mons.name: Luxio
mons.dex: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause opponents to faint. It lives in small groups.

mons.name: Luxray
mons.dex: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

mons.name: Budew
mons.dex: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

mons.name: Roserade
mons.dex: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

mons.name: Cranidos
mons.dex: It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

mons.name: Rampardos
mons.dex: Its powerful headbutt has enough force to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

mons.name: Shieldon
mons.dex: A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

mons.name: Bastiodon
mons.dex: Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

mons.name: Burmy Plant Cloak
mons.dex: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

mons.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
mons.dex: When Burmy evolves, its cloak becomes a part of its body. Wormadam’s cloak is never shed.

mons.name: Mothim
mons.dex: It loves the nectar of flowers and steals nectar collected by Combee.

mons.name: Combee
mons.dex: Three Pokémon joined to become one. It busily carries sweet nectar to Vespiquen.

mons.name: Vespiquen
mons.dex: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on nectar collected by Combee.

mons.name: Pachirisu
mons.dex: It stores its own fur balls that crackle with static electricity together with its favorite berries in tree hollows.

mons.name: Buizel
mons.dex: When air fills the flotation sac on its neck, the sac balloons like an inner tube. This Pokémon floats with its head out of the water.

mons.name: Floatzel
mons.dex: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

mons.name: Cherubi
mons.dex: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

mons.name: Cherrim Overcast Form
mons.dex: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. The Pokémon tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

mons.name: Shellos West Sea
mons.dex: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

mons.name: Gastrodon West Sea
mons.dex: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

mons.name: Ambipom
mons.dex: To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

mons.name: Drifloon
mons.dex: It is a Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

mons.name: Drifblim
mons.dex: They’re drowsy in daytime but fly off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

mons.name: Buneary
mons.dex: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

mons.name: Lopunny
mons.dex: An extremely cautious Pokémon that cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

mons.name: Mismagius
mons.dex: Its cries sound like incantations. Those who hear it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

mons.name: Honchkrow
mons.dex: Becoming active at night, it is known to form flocks with numerous Murkrow in tow.

mons.name: Glameow
mons.dex: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

mons.name: Purugly
mons.dex: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

mons.name: Chingling
mons.dex: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

mons.name: Stunky
mons.dex: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

mons.name: Skuntank
mons.dex: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. It can fire this spray more than 160 feet.

mons.name: Bronzor
mons.dex: Implements shaped like Bronzor were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown whether they are related.

loc.r: Mt. Coronet - Tunnel to Route 211 Entrance

mons.name: Bronzong
mons.dex: One caused a media storm when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

mons.name: Bonsly
mons.dex: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.

mons.name: Mime Jr.
mons.dex: It habitually mimics foes. The mimicked foe is said to be unable to look away from Mime Jr.

mons.name: Happiny
mons.dex: It loves round, white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of Chansey.

mons.name: Chatot
mons.dex: They can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

mons.name: Spiritomb
mons.dex: It is a Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

mons.name: Gible
mons.dex: It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

mons.name: Gabite
mons.dex: There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal incurable illnesses.

mons.name: Garchomp
mons.dex: When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

mons.name: Munchlax
mons.dex: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing it whole with almost no chewing.

mons.name: Riolu
mons.dex: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

mons.name: Lucario
mons.dex: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

mons.name: Hippopotas
mons.dex: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

mons.name: Hippowdon
mons.dex: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

mons.name: Skorupi
mons.dex: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

mons.name: Drapion
mons.dex: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

mons.name: Croagunk
mons.dex: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

mons.name: Toxicroak
mons.dex: Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

mons.name: Carnivine
mons.dex: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat its prey.

mons.name: Finneon
mons.dex: After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

mons.name: Lumineon
mons.dex: It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing patterns on its four fins.

mons.name: Mantyke
mons.dex: A friendly Pokémon that senses the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.

mons.name: Snover
mons.dex: It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

mons.name: Abomasnow
mons.dex: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

mons.name: Weavile
mons.dex: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

mons.name: Magnezone
mons.dex: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Its three units generate magnetism.

edges: Level Up in Magnetic Field / Use Thunder Stone

mons.name: Lickilicky
mons.dex: It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

mons.name: Rhyperior
mons.dex: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. On rare occasions, the Pokémon even shoots out Geodude.

mons.name: Tangrowth
mons.dex: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

mons.name: Electivire
mons.dex: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of electricity.

mons.name: Magmortar
mons.dex: It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

mons.name: Togekiss
mons.dex: It will never appear where there is strife. Sightings of this Pokémon have recently become rare.

mons.name: Yanmega
mons.dex: By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

mons.name: Leafeon
mons.dex: Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

edges: Use Leaf Stone / Level Up By Moss Rock
Use Ice Stone / Level Up By Ice Rock
Friendship + Fairy Move / Use Shiny Stone

mons.name: Glaceon
mons.dex: As a defense mechanism, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand out like needles.

edges: Use Leaf Stone / Level Up By Moss Rock
Use Ice Stone / Level Up By Ice Rock
Friendship + Fairy Move / Use Shiny Stone

mons.name: Gliscor
mons.dex: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, Gliscor swoops!

mons.name: Mamoswine
mons.dex: Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The ice age is over and the climate has warmed, so this Pokémon’s population has thinned.

mons.name: Porygon-Z
mons.dex: Additional software was installed to make it an even better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

mons.name: Gallade
mons.dex: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using the extending swords on its elbows.

mons.name: Probopass
mons.dex: Its entire body exudes strong magnetism. Probopass controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

mons.name: Dusknoir
mons.dex: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

mons.name: Froslass
mons.dex: It freezes foes with an icy breath that is nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

mons.name: Rotom
mons.dex: Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

mons.name: Uxie
mons.dex: Known as the Being of Knowledge, it is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

mons.name: Mesprit
mons.dex: It is known as the Being of Emotion. It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

mons.name: Azelf
mons.dex: It is known as the Being of Willpower. It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

mons.name: Dialga
mons.dex: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

mons.name: Palkia
mons.dex: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

mons.name: Heatran
mons.dex: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

mons.name: Regigigas
mons.dex: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

mons.name: Giratina Altered Forme
mons.dex: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

mons.name: Cresselia
mons.dex: When it flies, it releases shiny particles from its veil-like wings. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

mons.name: Phione
mons.dex: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

mons.name: Manaphy
mons.dex: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

mons.name: Darkrai
mons.dex: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of a new moon.

mons.name: Shaymin Land Forme
mons.dex: It lives in common flower patches but is rarely noticed. It is often mistaken for a flowering plant when curled up.

mons.name: Blank Plate Arceus
mons.dex: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

mons.name: Litwick
mons.dex: The younger the life this Pokémon absorbs, the brighter and eerier the flame on its head burns.

mons.name: Lampent
mons.dex: It lurks in cities, pretending to be a lamp. Once it finds someone whose death is near, it will trail quietly after them.

mons.name: Chandelure
mons.dex: In homes illuminated by Chandelure instead of lights, funerals were a constant occurrence— or so it’s said.

mons.name: Sylveon
mons.dex: There’s a Galarian fairy tale that describes a beautiful Sylveon vanquishing a dreadful dragon Pokémon.

edges: Use Leaf Stone / Level Up By Moss Rock
Use Ice Stone / Level Up By Ice Rock
Friendship + Fairy Move / Use Shiny Stone

mons.name: Pikipek
mons.dex: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!

mons.name: Trumbeak
mons.dex: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.

mons.name: Toucannon
mons.dex: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

mons.name: Obstagoon
mons.dex: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.

mons.name: Perrserker
mons.dex: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.

mons.name: Cursola
mons.dex: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.

mons.name: Sirfetch’d
mons.dex: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.

mons.name: Mr. Rime
mons.dex: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.

mons.name: Wyrdeer
mons.dex: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.

mons.name: Kleavor
mons.dex: It has a steel-hard body. It intimidates foes by upraising its eye-patterned pincers.

mons.name: Ursaluna
mons.dex: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.

mons.name: Sneasler
mons.dex: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

mons.name: Overqwil
mons.dex: It shoots the poison spikes on its body in all directions. Its round form makes it a poor swimmer.

mons.name: Tinkatink
mons.dex: This kindhearted Pokémon nurses sick Pokémon to health. It senses feelings of sadness.

mons.name: Alolan Sandslash

mons.name: Alolan Vulpix

mons.name: Alolan Ninetales

mons.name: Alolan Diglett

mons.name: Alolan Dugtrio
mons.dex: Its three heads move alternately, driving it through tough soil to depths of over 60 miles.

mons.name: Alolan Meowth

mons.name: Alolan Persian
mons.dex: It is a very haughty Pokémon. Among fans of Persian, the size of the jewel in its forehead is a topic of much talk.

mons.name: Hisuian Growlithe
mons.dex: It is a Pokémon with a loyal nature. It will remain motionless until it is given an order by its Trainer.

mons.name: Hisuian Arcanine
mons.dex: Its proud and regal appearance has captured the hearts of people since long ago.

mons.name: Alolan Geodude
mons.dex: Many live on mountain trails and remain half-buried while keeping an eye on climbers.

mons.name: Alolan Graveler
mons.dex: Graveler make their homes on sheer cliff faces that have numerous holes in them.

mons.name: Alolan Golem
mons.dex: It sheds its hide once a year. Its boulder-like body is so tough, even dynamite can’t harm it.

mons.name: Galarian Ponyta
mons.dex: About an hour after birth, Ponyta’s fiery mane and tail grow out, giving the Pokémon an impressive appearance.

mons.name: Galarian Rapidash
mons.dex: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.

mons.name: Galarian Slowpoke
mons.dex: Although slow, it is skilled at fishing with its tail. It does not feel pain if its tail is bitten.

mons.name: Galarian Slowbro
mons.dex: Though usually dim-witted, it seems to become inspired if the Shellder on its tail bites down.

mons.name: Galarian Farfetch’d
mons.dex: It can’t live without the stalk it holds. That’s why it defends the stalk from attackers with its life.

mons.name: Alolan Grimer
mons.dex: It was born when sludge in a dirty stream was exposed to the moon’s X-rays. It appears among filth.

mons.name: Alolan Muk
mons.dex: A toxic fluid seeps from its body. The fluid kills plants and trees immediately upon contact.

mons.name: Stitched Gengar
mons.dex: It hides in shadows. It is said that in rooms where Gengar is hiding, the temperature drops by nearly 10 degrees Fahrenheit.

mons.name: Crystal Onix
mons.dex: When it travels underground, it causes rumbling and tremors. It can move at 50 mph.

mons.name: Hisuian Voltorb
mons.dex: It looks just like a Poké Ball. It is dangerous because it may electrocute or explode on touch.

mons.name: Hisuian Electrode
mons.dex: It is known to drift on winds if it is bloated to bursting with stored electricity.

mons.name: Alolan Exeggutor
mons.dex: It is called the Walking Jungle. If a head grows too big, it falls off and becomes an Exeggcute.

mons.name: Alolan Marowak
mons.dex: The bones it uses have been in its possession since it was born. It has a ferocious nature.

mons.name: Galarian Weezing
mons.dex: It grows by feeding on gases released by garbage. Though very rare, triplets have been found.

mons.name: Galarian Mr. Mime
mons.dex: It is a pantomime expert that can create invisible but solid walls using miming gestures.

mons.name: Galarian Slowking
